survey: The curved hull is viewed slightly from above, revealing the deck and upper railings. Three masts rise from the deck, with sails suspended from crossbars and ropes connecting them to the ship. The crossbars share a consistent tilt, and the sails curve coherently around them. Three elliptical portholes sit along the hull’s side, while curved plank lines follow its shape. Waves overlap the lower hull consistently at the waterline.
